meta.title: Hyderabad new domestic water connection grid-only evidence ledger
meta.disclaimer: Independent research, not official advice. Grid-only benchmark run: sources and claims only, no nodes, edges, roadblocks or journeys. Desk research, no counter visited. Limitations: the board's site is fronted by a bot-detection challenge that a plain HTTP client could not pass, so the pages were read in a browser; no CAPTCHA was solved or attempted; the application, status and area-officer routes were read but never filled in, submitted or queried; four of the five source URLs have no Wayback snapshot, so nothing archived preserves what was observed; the service level agreement document sets out both an existing and a revised procedure and the reviewed evidence does not establish which is in force on the access date. Do not submit personal data through this ledger. Audit limitations carried unresolved: the sanctioning office for a 15mm domestic connection is not named by any reviewed route, the charter naming the Single Window Cell only for connections of 20mm and above; and archive captures were queried but never pushed for four of the five sources, so nothing archived preserves what was observed.

agencies.name: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board

scenarios.label: Hyderabad new domestic water connection
scenarios.summary: The individual owner of a built residential property with no connection applies to the city's water utility for a new domestic water supply, with sewer only where the same application covers it. Bulk or high-rise connections, commercial use, regularisation of unauthorised connections, name transfer on an existing account and tanker supply are excluded.
